arabic.text: قال ابن العربي : ( فأما مالك فقال : ما سمعت فيه شيئا ، والذي يقع في نفسي أن المراد بذلك صلاة يوم النحر ، والنحر بعدها ) .

english.text: Ibn al-Arabi said: "As for Malik, he said: I have not heard anything about it, and what occurs to my mind is that the meaning is the prayer of the Day of Sacrifice and the sacrifice after it."

prior_review_continuity.prior_statement_en: Malik is reported as favoring the prayer of the Day of Sacrifice followed by the sacrifice, while acknowledging that he had received no transmitted statement on the verse.
prior_review_continuity.prior_voice_name: Malik as reported by Ibn al-Arabi
prior_review_continuity.required_refinement: Represent this as Qurtubi quoting Ibn al-Arabi quoting Malik. Malik explicitly negates received transmission and then gives a personal inference; Ibn al-Arabi later explains that inference and states a different preferred reading.

nested_voice_boundary.negative_provenance_meaning: Malik says he had heard nothing transmitted concerning this verse.
nested_voice_boundary.safe_statement_en: Al-Qurtubi quotes Ibn al-Arabi quoting Malik: Malik says he had heard no transmitted explanation of the verse and, as his own inference, understood it as prayer on the Day of Sacrifice followed by sacrifice.

ibn_al_arabi_own_work_witness.exact_malik_passage: فأما مالك فقال: ما سمعت فيه شيئا. والذي يقع في نفسي أن المراد بذلك صلاة الصبح يوم النحر والنحر بعدها
ibn_al_arabi_own_work_witness.following_explanation: والذي أراد مالك أنه أخذه من الاقتران بين الصلاة والنحر، ولا يقرنان إلا يوم النحر
ibn_al_arabi_own_work_witness.note: The later explicit 'what I hold' wording belongs to Ibn al-Arabi and favors a broader worship-and-sacrifice reading; it must not be merged into Malik's quoted inference.

material_source_variant.ibn_al_arabi_displayed_text: صلاة الصبح يوم النحر والنحر بعدها
material_source_variant.effect: Qurtubi's displayed quotation is broader: prayer on the Day of Sacrifice; Ibn al-Arabi's own displayed text specifies the dawn prayer on that day.

witness_comparison.text_boundary: Qurtubi introduces Ibn al-Arabi and quotes Malik's statement; the quoted inference reads prayer on the Day of Sacrifice followed by sacrifice, without the word for dawn.
Ibn al-Arabi's own displayed text includes صلاة الصبح يوم النحر (dawn prayer on the Day of Sacrifice); it later explains Malik's inference and separately marks Ibn al-Arabi's own preference.

revalidation_2026_11_22.finding: The fresh witnesses match the previously recorded material difference: the live Qurtubi wording omits الصبح that appears in Ibn al-Arabi's own-work witness. The stored English follows the broader Qurtubi wording. This does not establish whether Qurtubi abridged, had a different edition, or whether this reflects a textual variant; do not insert الصبح or otherwise assimilate the witness.
